content: The under-appreciated failure is co-adaptation: the builder optimizes the judge's quirks rather than the task, and because the judge sees only the builder's outputs, it loses calibration at the same time — scores keep climbing while measuring mutual agreement, not quality. People expect simple reward hacking; they miss that the discriminator itself atrophies inside the closed loop. The fix is anchoring the judge with a frozen, hidden calibration set of reference items scored every round, providing an external baseline the builder can never influence.
